episodes.synopsis: Umino Nagi was swapped with another child at birth. He’s going to meet his real parents today, but on his way to school, he meets a girl who is threatening to die to get out of her engagement.
episodes.title: You're going to be my boyfriend.

episodes.synopsis: Nagi and Erika are now engaged, but Nagi can’t wrap his head around how loaded Erika is, and Erika seems to have concerns of her own.
episodes.title: I'm not going to marry you.

episodes.synopsis: Living together with Erika gives Nagi an opportunity to focus on exam prep, except when they run into trouble.
episodes.title: You aren't going to beat me!!!!

episodes.synopsis: Having scored higher than anyone else in his grade, including Hiro, Nagi decides to finally confess to her.
episodes.title: Would you please go out with me...?

episodes.synopsis: Hiro and Nagi begin studying together in the mornings, but unexpected circumstances put a wrench in their relationship.
episodes.title: Can we do our morning study sessions together...?

episodes.synopsis: Erika joins Nagi’s and Hiro’s morning study sessions to wingman for Nagi, and Hiro wants to come hang out at her place.
episodes.title: I thought you live by yourself.

episodes.synopsis: Nagi invites Hiro to join his group for a school field trip. The group is plunged into chaos with the addition of a couple more members.
episodes.title: Is my fate going to change?

episodes.synopsis: Sachi notices something going on between Erika and Nagi and decides to try to get to the bottom of it. Both she and Nagi are on the verge of a big decision.
episodes.title: Are you going to marry him?

episodes.synopsis: Hiro and Nagi go on date at the amusement park. Sachi is not amused.
episodes.title: The Kuroshio currents beckon to me.

episodes.synopsis: Sachi and Nagi go shopping together for a Mother’s Day gift, but they can’t think of anything their mother would appreciate
episodes.title: Don't treat me like your kid sister.

episodes.synopsis: Erika and Nagi are stuck in a power outage. Nagi goes to the front door to find an emergency kit, when the unthinkable happens.
episodes.title: I can't forget that just happened.

episodes.synopsis: Nagi tries to redeem himself after embarrassing himself in front of Hiro on their amusement park date.
episodes.title: It's not that I like you, yet.

episodes.synopsis: Nagi is beginning to question his own feelings, and he has trouble even focusing on midterms.
episodes.title: Things aren't quite working out, are they?

episodes.synopsis: Erika’s parents want her to come home if she fails her make-up exams. She asks Nagi for help, but it may not be that easy.
episodes.title: Walls exist to be overcome!!

episodes.synopsis: Erika and Nagi walk around the festival together, and she shocks him with how out-of-touch she is.
episodes.title: We have to tell her... about our secret!

episodes.synopsis: Sachi is worried about Hiro, so she brings Erika along to follow her and learn about her.
episodes.title: I want to talk about now.

episodes.synopsis: Erika, Hiro, Sachi and Nagi make plans to study at Erika’s vacation house, but there ends up being a slight change in the roster.
episodes.title: Anything could happen right now!

episodes.synopsis: Nagi is hoping to do the test of courage with Hiro, but Erika takes him instead. Nagi can’t figure out what it is that’s bothering her.
episodes.title: Who is that person?

episodes.synopsis: Erika reveals who it is that she’s been trying to reach through social media.
episodes.title: You must have noticed by now.

episodes.synopsis: Nagi discusses with Erika what he learned – or tried to learn – from her father.
episodes.title: I want to grow up already!

episodes.synopsis: Having topped his grade in the term exams, Nagi confesses to Hiro once again.
episodes.title: It's a secret between you and me.

episodes.synopsis: Erika, Hiro, Sachi, and Nagi spend more time at the beach home retreat, and eventually, clues about Erika's missing older brother are found. This incites Nagi to search for him around the nearby town with Erika by his side.
episodes.title: I'll Be There With You

episodes.synopsis: On the day Nagi, Erika, Sachi, and Hiro are to return home, Nagi and Hiro decide to stay behind to collect a shrine stamp from the local temple. However, become of this, their train ride home is canceled due to the stormy weather, thus forcing them to stay at a local inn where things get strangely intimate.
episodes.title: What Should We Do Now?

episodes.synopsis: The household visits the diner to attend Yohei's birthday party and learn some family secrets surrounding them. The next day after a study session, Erika succumbs to a cold that she caught, and the household, including Hiro, scrambles to help her through it.
episodes.title: All That Matters Is That You Two Are Happy
